title: Dispatch-time claim-evidence freshness guard
behavior: Schedule preview and creation require the live claim review to remain current through the selected due time.
The due worker rechecks at claim time and records CLAIM_EVIDENCE_CHANGED before creating an attempt or calling the provider.
Manual and scheduled dispatch recheck at attempt reservation and again in the durable SUBMITTING transaction immediately before provider work.
A successful submission stores only a sanitized claim-review receipt with the YouTube policy snapshot; evidence URLs, labels and override reasons are excluded.
Claim-free content and complete owner-override-only reviews retain existing behavior.
Portable checkpoint packaging excludes linked-worktree .git metadata files as well as normal .git directories.

focusedProof.test: claim evidence is rechecked at scheduling, reservation, due claim, and submission
assertions: Evidence current at review time but expired by the requested due time blocks schedule preview.
Evidence expired after schedule creation moves the due row to NEEDS_REVIEW with CLAIM_EVIDENCE_CHANGED.
Expired evidence blocks the manual dispatcher with zero provider calls and zero attempt rows.
Evidence expiring after reservation blocks SUBMITTING and leaves policySnapshot and startedAt unset.
After freshness restoration the same pre-provider RESERVED attempt can enter SUBMITTING.
The stored claim-review receipt contains no sourceUrl or source hostname.

verification.fontSet: SHA-verified Ubuntu fonts-noto-core 20201225-2 and four SHA-pinned Noto CJK OTF fonts

excludedExploratoryRun.reason: The first focused harness run lacked the documented local Noto font set and failed two render recovery cases before final verification.
excludedExploratoryRun.finalIdenticalSourceRecoveryRerun: 5/5 passed after restoring the checksum-matched font package

limitations: No evidence URL is fetched and no DNS lookup occurs; reachability, public routing, availability and credibility are not certified.
The guard does not establish claim truth, source quality, legal compliance or platform compliance.
No live Google request or deployed production acceptance was performed.
Local database verification used PGlite; POLICY-01C has no own native PostgreSQL CI yet.
Native PostgreSQL plus private-media backup/restore and full master acceptance remain open. POLICY-01 remains Partial.
